title: CaTS: Calibrated Test-Time Scaling for Efficient LLM Reasoning
authors_zh: Chengsong Huang、Langlin Huang、Jixuan Leng、Jiacheng Liu、Jiaxin Huang（机构以官方论文为准）
paper_type_zh: 校准式自适应测试时扩展论文（ICLR 2026）
best_for_zh: 设计置信度引导采样或推理预算评测的研究者。
one_line: CaTS distills self-consistency confidence to allocate repeated-sampling budget and stop easy queries early.
CaTS 将自一致性得到的置信度蒸馏为可校准信号，用于在固定平均预算下动态停止或分配重复采样。
why: It makes the confidence estimator and the sample budget part of the same reproducible inference contract.
inclusion_reason: It turns calibrated confidence into an explicit policy for allocating a finite repeated-sampling budget.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A fixed number of samples gives easy and difficult prompts the same inference budget. Self-consistency can indicate when a model is confident, but its raw agreement score is not reliably calibrated, so treating it as a stopping signal may save compute on the wrong questions.

This paper asks how a reasoning system can turn its own repeated answers into a calibrated estimate of correctness and then use that estimate to allocate samples. The aim is to improve the accuracy–cost trade-off without pretending that one global best-of-N budget is appropriate for every prompt.

固定的采样数量会给简单提示和困难提示同样的推理预算。自一致性能够表明模型何时自信，但其原始一致分数并不一定校准可靠，因此把它直接当作停止信号，可能会在错误的问题上节省计算。

本文研究推理系统如何把自身的重复回答转化为经校准的正确性估计，并利用该估计分配样本。目标是在不假装一个全局最佳候选预算适合每个提示的前提下，改善准确率与成本之间的权衡。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
CaTS treats self-consistency as a cheap but imperfect confidence source. It learns to calibrate that confidence, then uses the calibrated quantity to decide whether a response should be accepted early, whether more samples are worthwhile, or how a sampled set should be aggregated.

The core claim is operational rather than rhetorical: confidence and computation must be evaluated together. A calibration model is valuable only if, at a matched average sample budget, it changes which queries receive additional inference and improves the final quality–efficiency frontier.

CaTS 把自一致性视为廉价但不完美的置信度来源。它学习校准这种置信度，再利用校准后的量决定是否应提前接受回答、是否值得继续采样，或应如何聚合已采样的集合。

核心主张是操作性的，而不只是表述上的：置信度和计算必须一起评估。校准模型只有在平均采样预算相同的情况下改变哪些问题获得额外推理，并改善最终质量—效率前沿时才有价值。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method first obtains confidence targets from repeated model generations and trains a self-calibration component to predict them from a single response. It instantiates this signal in confidence-aware self-consistency, early stopping, and adaptive-sampling procedures rather than changing the base reasoning model.

Evaluation compares these procedures under controlled sample budgets across nine reasoning datasets and several instruction-tuned models. The important record is a prompt together with its sampled answers, agreement-derived target, calibrated confidence, allocation decision, and final aggregation; without that record, reported savings cannot be reconstructed.

该方法先从重复生成的模型回答中获得置信度目标，再训练一个自校准组件从单个回答预测这些目标。它把这一信号用于置信度感知的自一致性、提前停止和自适应采样过程，而不是修改基础推理模型。

评估在九个推理数据集和多个指令微调模型上，以受控采样预算比较这些过程。重要的记录包括提示、其采样回答、由一致性得到的目标、校准置信度、分配决定和最终聚合；没有这些记录，报告的节省无法复现。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across three models and nine datasets, the paper reports that calibrated procedures improve the quality achieved for a given repeated-sampling budget. One reported example is CaTS-ES on MathQA, where the result rises from 73.7 to 83.6 with an average budget of 16 samples.

These results demonstrate a budget-matched improvement for the tested models and tasks, not a universal guarantee that calibration transfers. The relevant comparison includes the confidence-prediction cost, the stopping rule, the distribution of samples per prompt, and the aggregation baseline, because a lower average budget can conceal expensive hard cases.

在三个模型和九个数据集上，论文报告校准过程提高了给定重复采样预算下可达到的质量。一个报告的例子是 MathQA 上的 CaTS-ES：在平均 16 个样本的预算下，结果从 73.7 提升到 83.6。

这些结果证明了在所测试模型和任务上的预算匹配改进，并非保证校准能够普遍迁移。相关比较必须包含置信度预测成本、停止规则、每个提示的样本分布和聚合基线，因为较低的平均预算可能掩盖昂贵的困难案例。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier repeated-sampling systems commonly use a fixed best-of-N or raw majority agreement. CaTS makes the reliability of that agreement an explicit learned object and uses it as a controller for inference allocation, rather than treating confidence as a post-hoc diagnostic.

The novelty therefore lies in linking a calibration target to a concrete action: stop, sample again, or aggregate. It does not introduce a new correctness oracle; the method inherits the base model’s answer space and the limitations of self-consistency when many samples share the same systematic error.

早期重复采样系统通常使用固定的最佳候选数或原始多数一致性。CaTS 把这种一致性的可靠性变成明确的学习对象，并将其用作推理分配控制器，而不是把置信度当作事后诊断。

因此，新意在于把校准目标连接到具体动作：停止、再次采样或聚合。它并没有引入新的正确性预言机；该方法继承基础模型的回答空间，也继承了许多样本共享同一系统性错误时自一致性的局限。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The approach is only as good as the relationship between agreement and correctness in its deployment distribution. A model can be confidently and consistently wrong, calibration can shift across domains or prompts, and an early-stopping policy can systematically underinvest in rare hard problems. The reported average sample budget also needs a tail analysis: a system may look efficient on average while placing most latency on a small subset of inputs. Reuse should re-estimate calibration on the intended model, task family, and decoding settings.
该方法的效果取决于部署分布中一致性与正确性之间的关系。模型可能自信而一致地出错，校准可能跨领域或提示发生漂移，提前停止策略也可能系统性地低估罕见难题的投入。报告的平均采样预算还需要尾部分析：系统平均上可能高效，却把大部分时延放在少量输入上。复用时应针对目标模型、任务族和解码设置重新估计校准。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when repeated decoding is already available and the practical question is which prompts deserve more samples. Benchmark a calibration-aware policy against fixed self-consistency at the same average and tail latency, logging each prompt’s confidence, sample count, final answer, and correctness. The paper is not a recipe for solving a task with no repeatable answer signal, nor does it replace a verifier for settings where answer agreement is a poor proxy for validity. Its value is to turn an otherwise hidden allocation decision into something measurable.
当重复解码已经可用，而实际问题是哪些提示值得更多样本时，可以使用本文。应在相同的平均和尾部时延下，将校准感知策略与固定自一致性比较，并记录每个提示的置信度、样本数、最终回答和正确性。本文并不是在没有可重复答案信号的任务上求解的配方，也不能替代答案一致性难以代表有效性的场景中的验证器。其价值在于把原本隐藏的分配决定变得可测量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The useful reading lens is “calibrate before allocating,” not “self-consistency is a verifier.” Check how confidence targets are produced, whether the calibration set overlaps the evaluation distribution, and whether sample savings include all auxiliary computation. Plot accuracy against both mean and high-percentile sample count. If a result is reported only at a nominal N without the realized per-query allocation, it does not establish that adaptive inference is more efficient; it establishes only that the final aggregate score changed.
有用的阅读视角是“先校准再分配”，而不是“自一致性就是验证器”。应检查置信度目标如何产生、校准集是否与评估分布重叠，以及样本节省是否包含所有辅助计算。准确率应同时相对于平均和高分位样本数作图。如果结果只在名义 N 下报告、却没有实际的逐题分配，它并不能证明自适应推理更高效；它只证明最终聚合分数发生了变化。
